whatIs: Yippy is a pack of hand-drawn vector illustrations, with icons and avatars for interfaces. Each piece downloads as SVG and PNG, and you can change its color to match your brand.
It's a good fit when you want a playful, consistent style for a landing page or an app, without paying or giving credit.
uses: Illustrate a landing page with a friendly, consistent style.
Use the avatars as sample profile pictures in a mockup.
Add illustrated icons to a features section.
caveats: You can't sell or distribute the illustrations, individually or in packs, or use them to offer a similar service.
It's only one pack among several on the site, so check that the style covers the topics you need.
pricingNote: Free for personal and commercial projects, with no required attribution.
idealFor: Landing pages and apps looking for hand-drawn illustrations at no cost.
